examples.title: Print a Greeting
examples.question: Write a Python program that prints the text Hello, World!.
examples.explanation: The print() function displays text in the console.

examples.title: Add Two Numbers
examples.question: Read two integers from the user and print their sum.
examples.code:
first = int(input("First number: "))
second = int(input("Second number: "))
print("Sum:", first + second)
examples.expected_output:
For inputs 4 and 6:
First number: 4
Second number: 6
Sum: 10
examples.explanation: input() reads text, int() converts the text to an integer, and + adds the two values.

examples.title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
examples.question: Read a temperature in Celsius and print its Fahrenheit equivalent.

examples.title: Check Even or Odd
examples.question: Read an integer and print Even if it is divisible by 2; otherwise print Odd.
examples.expected_output:
For input 7:
Enter an integer: 7
Odd
examples.explanation: The modulo operator (%) returns the remainder. An even integer has remainder 0 when divided by 2.

examples.title: Print Numbers from 1 to 5
examples.question: Use a for loop to print the integers from 1 through 5, one per line.
examples.explanation: range(1, 6) produces 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 because the stop value is excluded.
